name: Mercury Editor Inline Editor
project_description:
Mercury Editor™ offers an alternative content authoring experience and page builder, replacing the “Add Content” and “Edit Content” forms in Drupal. With Mercury, the content edit form is moved into a resizable offcanvas tray along the right side of the screen, and a live, interactive preview is rendered on the left. Any Layout Paragraphs fields enabled for a content type will be rendered in the “Builder” mode – providing a what-you-see-is-what-you-get page builder for content creators.

 
 Part of the Mercury Editor™ ecosystem 
 

Mercury Editor is the flagship of the Mercury Editor ecosystem. Mercury Editor empowers content editors to create custom layouts in seconds with an easy-to-use Drupal page builder.
 

 
 Back to top 

 Mercury Editor™ Features 
 
 Create complex layouts in seconds with Mercury’s easy-to-use page builder. 
 Drag-and-drop custom components to build flexible, visually compelling landing pages. 
 Allow content authors to select pre-built templates, enhancing the efficiency of the page building experience for non-technical users. 
 Instantly preview your work for mobile and tablet devices. 
 Control which components can be used in specific contexts, ensuring content authors work within established design and editorial guidelines. 
 Unlike many of its competitors, Mercury Editor is free software with no licensing or ongoing subscription costs. 
 
 Back to top 

 Getting Started 
 
 Important! Follow the Getting Started instructions at Layout Paragraphs to enable drag-and-drop behavior for Paragraphs fields on your content types. 
 Enable the Mercury Editor module. 
 Go to Mercury Editor Settings (Administration > Configuration > Mercury Editor settings). 
 Select the content/entity types with which you want to use Mercury Editor. Save the configuration. 
 Mercury Editor should now be enabled for your entity types, and any Layout Paragraphs fields will display in Mercury’s WYSIWYG preview pane!
